verdict.rationale: Unit's own API exposes account, transaction, payment, card and customer data, with real-time balances. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec and a full-replica sandbox make it a clean programmatic surface for an agent, with no dashboard scraping needed. Pending activity is not evidenced, documents are only implied by a sandbox statement-generation simulation, and there is no MCP server. missing for 10: explicit pending/authorization activity reads, a documented statements/documents retrieval API, an MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration of agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read the full banking picture — accounts, transactions, pending activity, documents — through a clean API or MCP surface without screen-scraping a dashboard

citations.quote: The Unit Dashboard and APIs provide teams with access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data.
with real-time balances and transaction data
An OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the Unit API is available here
Unit's Sandbox environment is a full replica of the production environment — all standard API endpoints work exactly the same way.
